node.title: E1 reduction to explicit exceptional prime set
node.statement: The e1_fullness problem reduces to control of an explicit exceptional set of row primes: every non-quotient e1 collision outside the paid antipodal class forces the admissible row prime to divide one of the nonzero bounded cyclotomic norms supplied by collision_norm_criterion; equivalently it is a sparse folded kernel vector in the lattice model. Small swap-distance pairs are already excluded by the proved radius threshold.
node.attack_surface: assembly of proved norm-divisor, sparse-kernel, radius, and almost-all-primes reductions
node.falsifier: a non-quotient e1 collision outside the norm-divisor exceptional set
